intent: IMPLEMENT IngestTelemetryService so the frozen test passes; Java 17, Spring Boot 3, non-blocking, no cross-context domain imports, no hardcoded config values. Spec: Telemetry Intake & Validation use case implementing IngestTelemetryUseCase. Constructor IngestTelemetryService(SensorMetricBoundaryPolicy policy, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetrySampleEvent> validatedSamples). Every sample is validated before propagation; each is mapped to TelemetrySampleEvent (status string VALID or VALIDATION_FAILED) and published in packet order with concatMap (TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed). Invalid samples are tagged, never dropped. Channel overflow error propagates to the caller (backpressure). No blocking calls.
